numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Year-on-year, the revenue of the Estonia-Sweden routes decreased by EUR 12.1 million to EUR 85.3 million. The segment result improved by EUR 1.4 million to a loss of EUR 1.2 million.'

numerical_claims.claim: The Other segment’s result remained broadly stable at EUR 28.5 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Revenue from the segment Other decreased by EUR 7.3 million... amounting to EUR 145.5 million. The segment result was EUR 28.5 million, remaining broadly in line with the previous financial year.'

numerical_claims.claim: Operating costs were pressured by higher personnel expenses, which rose 4.3% to EUR 201.0 million, and fuel and emission costs, which increased to EUR 96.5 million.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 201.0 million EUR personnel expenses, 96.5 million EUR fuel/emission costs
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 201.0 million EUR (2025) vs 192.8 million EUR (2024) personnel expenses [4.3% increase]; 96.5 million EUR (2025) vs 95.8 million EUR (2024) fuel/emission costs
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s total personnel expenses amounted to EUR 201.0 million (EUR 192.8 million in FY24)... Fuel and emission costs for the financial year 2025 amounted to EUR 96.5 million (EUR 95.8 million in the financial year 2024).'

numerical_claims.claim: Depreciation and amortisation fell EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million, including a EUR 16.7 million reduction from extending the estimated useful lives of most cruise and passenger vessels to 45 years.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 79.8 million EUR D&A, EUR 16.7 million reduction from life extension
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 79.8 million EUR (2025) vs 97.8 million EUR (2024) D&A; EUR 16,684 thousand (approx 16.7 million) reduction from life extension
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Amortisation and depreciation expense decreased by EUR 18.0 million to EUR 79.8 million year-on-year... Depreciation expense decreased mainly due to the alignment of the estimated useful lives of the cruise and passenger vessels (except for shuttle vessels) to 45 years... The total effect of the change was EUR 16,684 thousand less depreciation expense in 2025.' Note 14 details the life extension.

numerical_claims.claim: Net finance costs also declined EUR 6.8 million to EUR 21.4 million as debt and interest rates fell.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As a result of a decreased outstanding loan balance and declining interest rates, net finance costs declined by EUR 6.8 million year-on-year to EUR 21.4 million in the financial year 2025 (EUR 28.3 million in the financial year 2024).'

numerical_claims.claim: The Group sold three vessels during the year and had no vessels in lay-up by the end of the third quarter, supporting fleet optimisation and generating EUR 78.8 million of disposal proceeds.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'During the financial year, the Group completed the sale of three vessels... Net cash flow from investing activities was EUR 46.1 million (EUR 3.2 million in the financial year 2024), including proceeds from disposals of EUR 78.8 million.' Also: 'The number of vessels in lay-up decreased from four at the end of the first quarter of 2025 to zero by the end of the third quarter of 2025.'

numerical_claims.claim: Net debt declined to EUR 432.4 million from EUR 537.7 million, and interest-bearing liabilities fell 19.9% to EUR 445.9 million, although net debt to EBITDA increased to 3.3 because of the lower EBITDA.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 432.4 million net debt, EUR 445.9 million interest-bearing liabilities, 3.3 net debt/EBITDA
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 432.4 million EUR (2025) vs 537.7 million EUR (2024) net debt; 445.9 million EUR (2025) vs 556.4 million EUR (2024) interest-bearing liabilities; 3.3 (2025) vs 3.1 (2024) net debt/EBITDA
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group’s net debt amounted to EUR 432.4 million compared to EUR 537.7 million as at 31 December 2024... The net debt to EBITDA ratio stood at 3.3 as at 31 December 2025 (3.1 as at 31 December 2024). At the end of the financial year 2025, interest-bearing liabilities totalled EUR 445.9 million, down by 19.9% compared to EUR 556.4 million at the end of the financial year 2024.'

numerical_claims.claim: Operating cash flow remained positive at EUR 127.1 million, while cash fell to EUR 13.5 million after EUR 44.6 million of dividends and EUR 113.5 million of loan and interest payments.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: EUR 127.1 million operating cash flow, EUR 13.5 million cash, EUR 44.6 million dividends, EUR 113.5 million payments
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 127.1 million EUR operating cash flow; 13.5 million EUR cash (2025) vs 18.7 million EUR (2024); 44.6 million EUR dividends; 113.5 million EUR loan/interest payments
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Group’s net operating cash flow for the financial year 2025 was positive at EUR 127.1 million... At 31 December 2025, the Group’s cash and cash equivalents totalled EUR 13.5 million (EUR 18.7 million at 31 December 2024). The decrease in cash and cash equivalents... was driven by the payment of dividends (EUR 44.6 million) and... repayment of loans and the related interest expense (EUR 113.5 million).'

numerical_claims.claim: The Group paid EUR 0.06 per share in dividends and plans to propose the same amount for 2026.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on 20 May 2025 adopted a resolution to pay a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share in 2025... In agreement with the Supervisory Board... the Management Board... will propose to the General Meeting of Shareholders that a dividend of EUR 0.06 per share be paid in 2026.'
